kebab_example: aliyun ccc dial-ex --instance-id d278629c-c687-4aa3-b044-4fe9b0120000 --caller 02285190000 --callee 15732030000 --rout-point paEF_1GAQXXJ --answer-mode 1 --provider example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DialEx

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
If AnswerMode is 0, specify the contact flow ID (ContractFlowId).
If AnswerMode is 1, specify the agent to answer the call in the format: ram_id@call_center_subdomain.
If AnswerMode is 2, specify the skill group queue (skill group queue).
Q: How do I find the call center subdomain? A: Location: https://ccc.aliyun.com/workbench/call_center_subdomain. Note: The call center subdomain must be the same as the one specified when you created the Cloud Call Center instance. This operation is case-sensitive for the subdomain
parameters.help_zh:
如果AnswerMode是0，则传入联系流ID（ContractFlowId）；
如果AnwserMode是1，则传入接听坐席，格式:ram_id@呼叫中心二级域名；
如果AnwserMode是2，则传入接听技能组队列(技能组queue)
Q:如何查找呼叫中心二级域名？ A: 位置：https://ccc.aliyun.com/workbench/呼叫中心二级域名， 注意：呼叫中心二级域名需要与创建云呼叫中心实例填写的保持一致，此接口会区分二级域名的大小写
parameters.name: rout_point

parameters.help_en:
The answer mode. Valid values:

0: ivr
1: agent
2: skillgroupid
parameters.help_zh:
接听方式。三种方式分别为：

parameters.name: answer_mode
